title: aespa: The Supernova Era
description: Relive aespa's huge 2024: the Supernova and Armageddon releases, the Whiplash EP and the year-end awards that followed.

questions.question: Which aespa song was pre-released on May 13, 2024, two weeks before the album Armageddon?
questions.fun_fact: Its futuristic music video, where each member shows off a superpower, passed 10 million views within about 10 hours of release.

questions.question: Armageddon, released on May 27, 2024, was aespa's first release of which type?
questions.fun_fact: The ten-track record had passed 1.02 million copies in pre-orders by its release day.

questions.question: Supernova hit No. 1 on the real-time, daily and weekly iChart rankings at once. What is that feat called?
questions.fun_fact: It also became aespa's first song to top the Circle Digital Chart, where it stayed at No. 1 for 11 non-consecutive weeks.

questions.question: How many grand prizes (daesang) did aespa win at the 2024 Melon Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: They took Artist, Album and Song of the Year among seven trophies, while Record of the Year went to (G)I-DLE, now known as i-dle.

questions.question: Supernova won Song of the Year at the 2024 MAMA Awards, the first MAMA held partly in which country?
questions.fun_fact: The first night was at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles; the rest moved to the Kyocera Dome in Osaka, where aespa left with six awards.

questions.question: Which aespa music video won Best Music Video at the 2024 MAMA Awards?
questions.fun_fact: The same video later won Best K-pop Video at the 2025 MTV Video Music Awards Japan.

questions.question: Whiplash, released on October 21, 2024, is aespa's which extended play?
questions.fun_fact: Besides the title track, the six-track EP includes Kill It, Pink Hoodie, Flowers and Just Another Girl.

questions.question: In March 2025, an English version of Whiplash came out alongside a remix by which DJ?
questions.fun_fact: The English version came out on March 27, 2025, bundled with the Aoki remix and a sped-up take of the song.

questions.question: What was the name of aespa's second world tour, launched in Seoul in June 2024?
questions.fun_fact: At the first Seoul shows each member unveiled a solo song, and the four tracks were released together on October 9, 2024.

questions.question: aespa opened 2024 with a remake of Regret of the Times. Which act first released the song?
questions.fun_fact: The remake was released on January 15, 2024, four months before Supernova arrived.

title: K-pop Solo Artists True or False
description: Ten true or false statements about K-pop soloists, from BoA and Rain to IU, Taeyeon, Jennie, Jisoo, Baekhyun and Jungkook.

questions.question: IU made her debut in 2008 with the EP Lost and Found.
questions.fun_fact: Her agency LOEN came up with the stage name IU, meant to express I and You becoming one through music.

questions.question: Rain launched his solo career in 2002 under SM Entertainment.
questions.fun_fact: He debuted solo under J. Y. Park's JYP Entertainment, releasing the album Bad Guy on May 13, 2002.

questions.question: BoA's Listen to My Heart was the first album by a Korean artist to top the Oricon Albums Chart.
questions.fun_fact: Released in Japan in March 2002, it was also the first record by a Korean artist certified million by the RIAJ for one million shipments.

questions.question: Taeyeon's debut studio album, released in 2017, was titled Purpose.
questions.fun_fact: Her first studio album was My Voice (2017). Purpose followed on October 28, 2019, as her second, with the single Spark.

questions.question: Jennie's debut solo studio album, Ruby, was released in 2025 by Odd Atelier and Columbia Records.
questions.fun_fact: The 15-track album features guests such as Dua Lipa, Doechii, Childish Gambino, Kali Uchis, Dominic Fike and FKJ.

questions.question: Sunmi released her 2017 hit Gashina while still signed to JYP Entertainment.
questions.fun_fact: She had moved to MakeUs Entertainment that year, and Gashina was a collaboration with The Black Label, led by producer Teddy Park.

questions.question: Jisoo's 2023 solo debut single, Flower, was released through SM Entertainment.
questions.fun_fact: It arrived on March 31, 2023, via YG Entertainment and Interscope, leading her first single album, Me.

questions.question: Chung Ha finished fourth on Produce 101 and became a member of the project group I.O.I.
questions.fun_fact: After I.O.I's run ended, she debuted as a soloist in 2017 with the EP Hands on Me.

questions.question: Jungkook's 2023 single Seven featured the rapper Cardi B.
questions.fun_fact: Seven featured Latto and debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100: Jungkook's first solo chart-topper and Latto's first ever.

questions.question: EXO's Baekhyun made his solo debut in 2019 with the EP City Lights.
questions.fun_fact: SM Entertainment released the six-track EP on July 10, 2019, with UN Village as its lead single.

title: TWICE: Cheer Up to Fancy Quiz
description: From Cheer Up to Fancy: test what you remember about TWICE's 2016 to 2019 singles, their music videos and the agency behind them.

questions.question: Which agency launched TWICE in 2015?
questions.fun_fact: Founder J. Y. Park chose the name TWICE: the group would touch hearts once through the ears and again through the eyes.

questions.question: In the Cheer Up music video, Sana dresses as which famous anime heroine?
questions.fun_fact: Every member plays a film or TV character, such as Tzuyu as Holly Golightly from Breakfast at Tiffany's.

questions.question: Which 2016 TWICE video shows the members in Halloween costumes such as Tinker Bell and Pinocchio?
questions.fun_fact: Chaeyoung appears as Ariel from The Little Mermaid, and the video closes with a To be continued message.

questions.question: Which 2017 TWICE video shows a slumber party, a snowball fight and a short cameo by J. Y. Park?
questions.fun_fact: Released on February 20, 2017, it led the special album Twicecoaster: Lane 2 and ends with the same scene as the TT video.

questions.question: In the Signal music video, the superpowered members meet what kind of visitor?
questions.fun_fact: Each member has a power, such as Momo's super speed, and by the end of the video the members turn into aliens too.

questions.question: The Likey music video was filmed entirely in which city?
questions.fun_fact: Likey was the lead single of TWICE's first studio album, Twicetagram, and leader Jihyo shot some of the footage herself.

questions.question: Which 2018 single's video has the members recreating scenes from films like Ghost and La La Land?
questions.fun_fact: The song earned TWICE their third Song of the Year award in a row at the 2018 Mnet Asian Music Awards.

questions.question: The Dance the Night Away video shows TWICE as castaways on a beach. Where was it filmed?
questions.fun_fact: Released on July 9, 2018, it was the lead single of Summer Nights, a reissue of their fifth EP.

questions.question: In the Yes or Yes music video, which object do the members use to have their fortunes told?
questions.fun_fact: It hit 100 million YouTube views on December 14, 2018, making ten TWICE music videos in a row to reach that mark.

questions.question: Which April 2019 single showed a more mature TWICE, with bold CGI backdrops in its video?
questions.fun_fact: Written by Black Eyed Pilseung and Jeon Goon, the retro electropop track led the group's seventh EP, Fancy You.

title: K-pop Grand Prize Winners
description: Who took the daesang? Test your memory of Artist and Album of the Year winners at the MAMA, Melon and Golden Disc Awards.

questions.question: Which act won the very first MAMA Artist of the Year award, presented in 2006?
questions.fun_fact: Super Junior took the award the following year, and BIGBANG won it in 2008.

questions.question: Through the 2025 ceremony, how many times had BTS won the MAMA Artist of the Year daesang?
questions.fun_fact: Their wins ran every year from 2016 to 2022, a streak no other act had matched as of 2025.

questions.question: Which group won MAMA Album of the Year five years in a row, from 2013 to 2017?
questions.fun_fact: The run began with XOXO and ended with The War, and BTS then won the next five editions from 2018 to 2022.

questions.question: Which group won the Melon Music Award for Artist of the Year in both 2011 and 2012?
questions.fun_fact: Girls' Generation had won the two previous editions, and SHINee took the award in 2013.

questions.question: Which band won Melon Album of the Year in both 2012 and 2013?
questions.fun_fact: They won first with Busker Busker 1st Album and again the next year with their second album.

questions.question: Which IU album was named Melon Album of the Year in 2017?
questions.fun_fact: She won the same grand prize again in 2021, that time with Lilac.

questions.question: At the 2022 Melon Music Awards, which singer took both Artist of the Year and Album of the Year?
questions.fun_fact: BTS received Record of the Year that night, and IVE won Song of the Year, the group's first ever daesang.

questions.question: Which TVXQ album won Album of the Year at the 2008 Mnet KM Music Festival?
questions.fun_fact: Released in September 2008 as their fourth Korean studio album, it also won the Disk Daesang at the 23rd Golden Disc Awards.

questions.question: Who won the Golden Disc Awards' new Artist Daesang, first given at the 40th ceremony in January 2026?
questions.fun_fact: The ceremony took place at the Taipei Dome, and Stray Kids won that year's Album Daesang with Karma.

questions.question: At the 2025 Melon Music Awards, who swept Song, Artist and Album of the Year?
questions.fun_fact: He won seven awards at Gocheok Sky Dome that night, while Record of the Year went to Jennie.

title: K-pop Virtual Idols
description: PLAVE, K/DA, MAVE: and naevis: ten questions on the virtual idols and digital singers who have made their mark on K-pop.

questions.question: Which agency is behind the virtual boy band PLAVE?
questions.fun_fact: In April 2024, Vlast's CEO said HYBE and YG Plus had invested in the company to help PLAVE expand overseas.

questions.question: Which single album marked PLAVE's formal debut in March 2023?
questions.fun_fact: PLAVE's name mixes the English word play with rêve, French for dream.

questions.question: In 2024, PLAVE became the first virtual idol group to win a Korean music show. With which song?
questions.fun_fact: The song took first place on both Show Champion and Show! Music Core.

questions.question: Which HYBE-run fan platform did PLAVE become the first virtual group to join?
questions.fun_fact: They announced the move during a livestream on December 12, 2023, and opened their official fan club membership there in early 2024.

questions.question: The members of the virtual girl group K/DA are versions of characters from which video game?
questions.fun_fact: Riot Games unveiled the group in 2018 with a mixed-reality performance at the World Championship opening ceremony in Incheon.

questions.question: Which two members of (G)I-DLE, now called i-dle, voice Ahri and Akali in K/DA?
questions.fun_fact: The other two characters are voiced by American singers: Madison Beer as Evelynn and Jaira Burns as Kai'Sa.

questions.question: What was K/DA's debut single, released on November 3, 2018?
questions.fun_fact: Within days it reached No. 1 on Billboard's World Digital Song Sales chart and on the US iTunes K-pop chart.

questions.question: The virtual girl group MAVE: was launched by an affiliate of which game company?
questions.fun_fact: Its four virtual members, SIU:, ZENA:, TYRA: and MARTY:, debuted on January 25, 2023, with the album Pandora's Box.

questions.question: Which agency debuted naevis, its first AI-generated singer, in 2024?
questions.fun_fact: She first appeared in aespa's fictional universe, where she helps the members travel to the digital world called Kwangya.

questions.question: What was the title of naevis's debut single, released in September 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Years before going solo, she showed up in the video for aespa's Black Mamba, released in November 2020.
